overall_reason: The figures (contact sheet #1 to #12) are the design system's own diagrams of button use, drawn in its own components, but about half carry Chinese strings baked into the image files on an English page.

score.reason: T-MATERIAL-SOURCE and T-ONE-REGISTER pass on 22 figures in one grey-plate frame at 2x, but T-TEXT-ON-IMAGE fails because the labels inside many figures are baked-in Chinese on the English page (IMG-011).

findings.where: figures under 'Emphasis', 'Special Button Types', 'Button Ordering' and 'Grouping Buttons', 1440 (contact sheet #1, #4, #9, #10, #12)
findings.evidence: The figure files carry their labels as pixels in Chinese: '高强调 主色填充' and '中强调' (#9), '主要操作 次要操作 警示操作' (#4), '下拉按钮 分离的下拉按钮 更多按钮' (#10), '你确定删除这项内容吗？' (#12). The surrounding page text and captions are English. Other figures (#2, #6) use grey bars in place of words.
findings.before: spec figures with Chinese labels baked into the bitmaps on the English edition
findings.after: Export each figure per locale with English labels, or rebuild the labels as HTML text over the figure so they translate with the page
findings.why: Readers of the English page cannot read the labels the figures use to explain emphasis and order.
findings.root: figure exports shared between the Chinese and English docs
